modules.name: Hutara PsyOperator
modules.description: Psychedelic Synthesizer,VCO with FM Synthesis, Resample and Waveshaper

modules.name: Hutara PsyOperator FX
modules.description: Modulation driven psychedelic performance processor: sustained varispeed tape engine with wow, flutter, tape stop, freeze and reverse, granular pitch and time engine, clocked slicer (1/4 to 1/128 incl. triplets), 16-step trance gate sequencer with per-step accent, swing and 1-8 ratchet, scatter time displacement, drive, tone and stereo width, with a visible modulation bus, bounded random modulation and control outputs (trance gate, end-of-slice trigger, clock thru, envelope follower)

modules.name: Hutara VOIDKICK
modules.description: Dedicated psytrance kick, sub and rolling bass voice: two stage exponential pitch glide with curve control, Chebyshev harmonic body morph, band limited click with noise spit and gnarl, asymmetric drive, fold and forest shapers with a void macro, separate kick and bass outputs, measured period 16th note bass grid with a stepped glide, V/OCT tracking, accent input, envelope and end of cycle outputs. Frozen legacy engine, see docs/PSYKICK.md; the next generation engine is the separate PsyKickMK2 model
